notes.title: New update for Frontier Pilot Simulator: Optimization and full readiness!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of a new update for Frontier Pilot Simulator! 

This release is the result of our hard work on optimizing the game, resulting in a significant improvement in its performance. 
The game now runs much smoother with no sudden FPS sags, providing you with an uninterrupted and immersive gaming experience.

It is especially important to note that in this update we have achieved 100% game readiness, meeting all our original plans. 
This means you're getting exactly what we envisioned from the beginning, and we're sure you'll love it!

In addition, we're excited to announce the release of Frontier Pilot Simulator on consoles! 
Now even more players will be able to immerse themselves in the exciting world of our pilot simulator.

Finally, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all players for their support and faith in us. 
This update was made possible thanks to your support and we appreciate each and every one of you.

notes.title: Game Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have some important news to share with you all about the game we have been working on. As many of you may already know, the development team consisted of employees from the Czech Republic, Ukraine, and Russia. Unfortunately, just before the end of last year, we experienced a break in development. This was further compounded by the outbreak of war, which ultimately led to the original team splitting up.

However, we are happy to announce that there is now another team working on the project, focused on porting the game to the PS5 and Xbox by the end of this year. We understand that many of you have been eagerly waiting for updates and we apologize for the long silence.

The future of the game will be decided after its release on these platforms. We appreciate the continued support and interest from our fans, and we thank you for your patience as we work towards a successful release.

Thank you, and stay tuned for further updates.

Best regards,
RAZAR team

notes.title: FAQ, Road Map, Animals
notes.content:
Ahoj, Pilots.

Thank you for testing and reviews. Great to see you are satisfied and we move in the correct direction. 
Mostly we have positive feedback, but still, you have some questions:

[list]
[*] [b]Why Scarab behave differently than other planes?[/b]
All mass is concentrated in the middle of the ship (rescue capsule), and it has a huge tail. That why it harder to turn in plane mode. 

[*] [b]Why some upgrades do not meet the described characteristics?[/b]
It's was testing build the main purpose of which was to test the flight physics of the standard plane setting. The upcoming update will meet all of the requirements. 

[*] [b]Why Hotas Thrutle inverted?[/b]
 We ll change it in the upcoming update.

[*] [b]Why controlling on the joysticks and gamepad is different?[/b]
 [olist]
[*] We didn't set up the sensitivity of the joystick the same way as the gamepad (just didn't have time) it will be fixed in the upcoming update.
[*] We didn't set the button for trimers. We will find the place and set it by default.
[/olist]

[*] [b]Why animation of the scarab engines is wrong?[/b]
We'll fix it in the upcoming update.

[*] [b]Why the ship lifts the nose after switching to the plane mode?[/b]
The basics of aerodynamics can explain it. Forces of the take-off VTOL direction can not go away. IF you want a smooth transition aline the ship and get some horizontal speed and then switch to the plane mode. 

[*] [b]Why there is no autopilot in the game?[/b]
 Once we ll creat animals logic behavior most likely we ll add auto-pilot
[/list]

[b]Also what we'll add to the upcoming update:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Reduce fuel consumption
[*] Ar mode consumption not gonna be changed (buy a special upgrade to remove the consumption).
[*] Simplify the Scarab controlling and make more realistic OX and Ballena

notes.content:
Hi Pilots,

Since the last update, we received some negative reviews from you regarding flight physics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29589799/fc48d3e08bb835abc458a635bf779b274ea100e9.png[/img]

[h3]TERMS[/h3]
Angle Alpha - the angle of attack (positive downward).
Beta Angle - Slide angle (positive to the right).

Fy = Cy 1/2 V2 S P; - lifting force perpendicular to the airspeed vector.
Fx = Cx 1/2 V2 S P; - the brake force coincides with the direction of the air velocity vector.

V - module (value) of airspeed
S - wing area
P - air density
Cx and Cy - coeff. braking and wing lift. Both depend on the angles of attack and glide

[b]An example of the dependence of Cy on the angle of attack[/b]

Asymmetrical wing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29589799/760099b6fe1324d41daef142202474738f92480d.png[/img]

Symmetrical wing

For asymmetrical wing
Same as above, but peaks at 90 and -90 degrees are the same


[b]An example of the dependence of Cy and Cx on the sliding angle[/b]
The graphs are taken for the right-wing,  left one is the symmetry to the ordinate axis.
A graph of the decrease in both coefficients from the wing slip towards the fuselage, taking into account the shading of the fuselage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29589799/34457f6aae0eda04fe51b0987e656562bcdcce29.png[/img]

This is a graph of the InOutQuintic Interpolation function
On the graph, at 70 degrees, the wing stops working - it is completely shaded.

[b]Graph of Cy versus the sliding angle away from the fuselage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29589799/c125f40a2f06bd79a32a9d4601d7750947e6155d.png[/img]

Cy = Abs (cos (beta))
With an increase in the sideways slip angle, the lift of the wing decreases.
Graph of Cx versus the sliding angle away from the fuselage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29589799/30a5354229bba44b73698e81e6c1901937aed2d0.png[/img]


With an increase in the angle of sliding to the side, the deceleration of the wing only increases. On the graph the odds. Cx increases from 1 to 1.4


[b]Fuselage braking.[/b]
The fuselage is a cylinder that has a braking force.

Only the braking force is calculated depending on the coefficient. Cx. The cylinder is symmetrical - therefore, sliding is not calculated.

Dependence of the Cx fuselage on the angle of attack.

notes.title: F.A.Q., Customization, Discord Group Call
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,
Yesterday we had a long group call with players in the discord. Thank you all for your participation. We will try to make it more often. They share their ideas and problems about the game. It was a very productive call.

We went through all steam topics and highlighted the most common questions. Here it is our answers:

[h3]VR[/h3] No we don't plan to add VR support in the release version (as part of DLC can be added)

[h3]Mouse control[/h3] No, it will never be added to the game.

[h3]Air Trafic[/h3]  Yes, it will be in the last update before release

[h3]Animals[/h3]  Yes, it will be in the last update before release

[h3]Customization[/h3] Yes, it will be in the next update

[h3]Flight model[/h3]  the game has a system that uses the jets to cancel drift in plane mode. The mode changing also changes the way thrust is calculated."Auto-Angle of Attack" is a system that (if ON) 'remove' extra lift to make you fly straighter. Plane-mode landing considered an extra feature originally - we will try to clear the terrain around runways.

How Bank turns works:
[olist]
[*]  ship dragged sideways - the tail began to slow down the ship thanks to the airflow, relative to the rest of the plane 
[*]  the tail slows down and causes a turn to the side and the top 
[*]  the more we accelerated to the side, the higher the speed to the side - the more the tail brakes, the more we are turned to a side and top 
[*]  after some time, the tail, due to a U-turn, no longer turns us around (it already partially follows the wind) 
[*]  but we have inertia - the turn continues due to mass 
[*]  and when the tail stops us - it beats against a stream of air from the other side 
[*]  and we stop turning 
[*]  ship drags again to the side - we again accelerate to the side - and again the tail begins to turn the ship.
[/olist]
[b]NOTE:[/b] the weight distribution of our ships is radically different from modern aircraft. Large weights are located at remote points from the center of mass: engines, which makes our aircraft much more inertial when turning for accelerating the turn and for braking.

[h3]Ski level[/h3] - As a part of the gameplay, we can not turn it off. We believe its the challenging part of the game.

[h3]CargoSpaceWay[/h3] We fixed the issue with Ski level, and now you can reach it easily.

[h3]AR energy consumption[/h3] We added a ship upgrade which reduces the consumption of the energy. Also, we reduced consumption by default. 

[h3]Ships[/h3] Comparison of the ship in the game with the real aircraft.  Scarab - it is a  helicopter (use for a short distance and landing in the extreme terrain), OX - a mix of the plane and VTOL - mixed flight mechanics, Ballena - C-5 Galaxy mostly use for heavy cargoes and long distances)

[h3]Day/Night[/h3] We do have a short day/night transitions until we add lights on the bases and plane it will be that short.

[h3]Encyclopedia[/h3] Yes, we can make it on our web site, and post it right before release.

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]   We have a help screen that explains all of the game controls. Please don't skip it, it will help you to understand the game. Regarding the classical tutorial, we don't want to make it the way - click this button and flight straight. The gameplay of the first island considered a tutorial. We can make explanatory topics about the flight model in the steam right before release.

[h3]Weather[/h3]     Weather is randomly changing as it is in the real world. (you can have bad luck and get 2 storms in the row), but we made a wether indicator, it will help you to plan the route.

[h3]Map[/h3]     We can not stop the game and allow the player to click "M" and watch the map. You have 2 indicators on the top of the screen for this purpose.

[h3]Track IR[/h3]     No, we don't plan to add it to the release.

[h3]Ultrawide support[/h3]    FPS support all of the screen sizes

[h3]New Ships[/h3] As a part of DLC.

[h3]Hotas[/h3] FPS support all kinds of joysticks - sometimes you would need to map it by your self.

[h2]Flight physics[/h2]
With each update, we updating the simulation part of the game. That why it became more difficult to control the ship in flight mode. Now you have to take into the consideration wing’s lifting force, flaps, ailerons, and aft.
For example, now the wing works only under certain (real) conditions, a certain attack angle, and not only vertically but also horizontally (which previously was not taken into account) i.e. now it’s impossible to fly sideways ..only if you want to crash. 
Also, we add Effects of overlap, i.e. when trying to level the plane, you can get into resonance and instead of leveling, only increase the amplitude of the plane’s vibrations plus you can get the spin effect.
[previewyoutube=EwY90_SRtco;full][/previewyoutube]
Besides, a crosswind has a very strong effect on flight. Precisely as a result of the fact that now the tail extension determines the direction of the hull.
Those additions have a huge impact on the small ship (SCARAB) auto-leveling turn off.  You would feel the rotation during the roll and the fixed angle of attack of the wing, influence of rudders, ailerons, trimmers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29589799/72262a9b0ca0921ed5984668113f1e7b13797fea.png[/img]
As a result, there are not only positive effects but also negative ones, such as lateral flow stall, flat corkscrew and other “fun moments” of aerobatics.

[h3][i][b]Record those effects and paste them to comments. It's important to us how players deal with it.
Each player will get a key if he'll share the video.[/b][/i][/h3]

The operating mode of the radar allows piloting even in conditions of insufficient visibility.
It is activated by the V button on the keyboard, Left Bumper + X on the gamepad or the ship's menu in the radar tab.
It consumes energy and turns off when the radar is damaged.

Also, the features of the bases, such as the presence of a runway, hangar, etc. Plus, filters allow you to focus only on the selected type of action.

notes.title: Big Update Vol.14 - Cockpit, New cameras, Trading system, Hangar, Optimization and etc.
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,
It happened the new HUGE update released. Now we officially a cockpit simulator. Thank you all for the support, ideas and help with development. You are the best community we can imagine. 
So, descriptions of the update below. + New trailer which showcases the new features. 

https://youtu.be/w9O_olJyTqg

[h1] Cockpit[/h1] 
By the thousands of requests, we integrated AR  system into the pilot's helmet. Now you can switch to two modes of view:
[olist]
[*] First person view, where we combined computer data reconstruction from the external sensors of the ship with the interior of the cabin
[*]  In the second mode, remains an insignificant part of the cabin and the possibility of shifting in the direction of gaze for even greater visibility (middle mouse button).[/olist]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/3ea5e4c1c7ec42ed65be0c8e14c499da262c5a6e.gif[/img]

[h1] New Trading mode system [/h1] 
Now the ship's systems automatically send a request to all available bases for the selected product and provide information about the distance and estimated prices. Also, we add a warning message if the cargo is heavy for a vertical take-off. Plus mouse support been added.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/6eef91cf2f9bdb5e540983ff3a5794570e8f30ec.png[/img]

[h1] Hangar[/h1] 
There was a total modernization of all the hangars systems, animations, arm movements. We added more manipulators and automation system, which significantly reduced the time of upgrade and repair. In general, we improved effects, angles and ten's of bugs fixed.

[h1] Reworked game engine.[/h1] 
It touched almost every aspect of the game. Due to this update, we were able to ad the first-person view, correct hundreds of graphics errors, related the shadows and tremor of models. Furthermore, we get rid of the map size limitation, will be able to add long-distance flights and add new islands&continents. Naturally, along with improvements and corrections of old bugs, new ones might appear. We hope you will treat with understanding and send us the feedback. The more detailed feedback will be the faster we fix it. 

[h1] Other[/h1] 
Fixed several bugs with the camera, landscape, effects, water, weather, and tasks.
Improved, corrected and optimized landscape and objects on it.
Improved sound system, taking into account the first-person view, diving under the water, weather, etc.
We Reworked part of the interfaces, screens, and screensavers.
We finally cleared the runway on Cargospaceway.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/126a150b9bcf902ee4c266aa0097838fba56451f.jpg[/img]

[b] What we will focus on, next?[/b] 

[h1] Parking cameras[/h1] 
We understand, that landing and maneuvering with a cockpit view are challenging, it is hard to understand the position of the ship relative to the landing site. That why, we will make several additional external cameras (top view, rear view camera, etc.) and display to the helmet interface.

[h1] Construction of the base in the canyon[/h1] 
We almost completed the new adventures and the construction of a base in the canyon. New cargos, tasks, upgrades and etc.

[h1] New map interface[/h1] 
Soon we will deal with serious processing of the map. We want to add to an interface for interacting with messages and selecting targets, as well as to refine the interface of the “economic part”, weather forecast, wind, etc.

Left side - current speed, Right Side - Current height.

Under it Estimate time left with current charge and below it estimated distance with current charge.

Current height and vertical speed (external scale)

Speed and max speed with current ship conditions, sonic speed, (external scale)

Hi Pilots,
A new portion of the internal working flow information arrived.

[h1]Cockpit[/h1]
So now let's talk about the HUD and controls. As you know game actions take place in the future. And technology changing so fast, everything becomes so intuitive and digital. That why we want you to represent our vision of it. (We implemented a lot of your ideas as well) 

[b]Scheme of the ship[/b]
Remember? everytime you getting crashed, rescue capsule saves your life and deliver you to the base. As you can see, the rescue capsule is a part of the ship and ship is the skeleton. That why its so easy to change ships.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/29b48c4dce7deb2efa63b2d8744a69946147e857.png[/img]

[b]The idea behind the controls[/b]
Most of you saw the movie "Pacific Rim". Do you remember the suit and Neural connection with the robot? We would like to follow that structure. The pilot wears Exosuit with the neural helmet which recognizes the impulses of your brain (read your mind), projects all the data onto the helmet visor. (helmet and exosuit interact with each other)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/e09b1dfa25465d5ca012b1698716cdc2258ca8f5.jpg[/img] (Pic was taken from the movie "Pacific Rim")

[b]Example[/b]: IF you want to turn left, you have to think and make a movement with your legs (like you push the pedals). Exosuit reads that data and send the signal to the helmet, helmet process the data and turn the ship to the left.

What will be physical in a cockpit: comfortable pilot seat, external pressure gauge, thermometer, chemical analyzer, a pyro-cartridge fuse lever, rocket launcher, VR laser projectors in case of built-in AR VR spacesuit system failure, window. 

[h1]Mod[/h1]
New game designer working hard on the new mod. The story will put you into the skin of the pilot who made a wrong decision because of the money. You will be so close to death, getting catch and etc.
Altogether there will be 13 quests. (More info next week)

notes.title: New news HEADLINE - Friday Report №1
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/e3e795de7744b45dbcbf550f832da7b9ad6d9dbe.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/59008c6bc790d2ce09f4fb4f1d00ea1424e158be.jpg[/img][/url]
Hi Pilots,

Thank you all for the support and purchases. We are at the most important part of the game development - HUD, Cockpit, and Workshop.
Those parts of the development consider a lot of interactions with players. That why we are announcing news headline "Friday Report".
Every Friday we will share everything what we did and what we are working on.  Feel free to discuss it and share new in the social network.

We are on:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/frontierpilot.net/
Discord - https://discord.gg/9Gez4ED
Twitter - https://twitter.com/frontierpilotsm
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/frontierpilotsimulator/

[h1]Passenger issue[/h1]
Most of you reported that passengers disappeared from the game, and there is no other alternative to make some money and pay debts. This issue been fixed and now at the testing stage.

[h1]Base disappearing[/h1]
We received some reports about disappearing texture of the bases. This issue at the fixing stage. Shader specialist is looking for the problem.

[h1]Crashes[/h1]
This is the biggest issue right now. Half of the team are looking for the solution.  The main suggestion is the reason is the old UNITY version. It will be check. And if it is the case, 2018 UNITY  should fix the problem.

[h1]Art - new concepts[/h1]
For our art team, it was a very productive week. We made a 3D model of the next ship.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/e3e795de7744b45dbcbf550f832da7b9ad6d9dbe.jpg[/img]
Now they are working with the 4 ship which calls Condor. This will be the biggest class of ship. Art of this ship will be posted next Friday.

[h1]HUD[/h1]
First of all, thank you for your suggestions and ideas. That what we come up with and explanations why we wanted to do it this way.

Prerequisites for this kind of interface.
[list]
[*] Functionality
[*] Simplicity
[*] VR support
[*] Appearance
[/list]
It is crucial to us what kind of impression HUD appearance new players have We really do not want the player to see the first frame of the game and exclaimed "Oh! Holly crap". One of the important goals is the scalable complexity of the appearance. We want to show only those indicators that are strictly necessary. And in fact, these are not so few. There are very basic things that a player needs to see in any case.
[list]
[*] Charge
[*] Height
[*] Speed
[/list]
Here are the three main indicators that, in our opinion, no doubt, the player must see during the flight.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/798d6f84278322bb707b1e28067bd0fda6c9df15.jpg[/img]
Such as average flow, estimated range, and so on. This information is optional and can be disabled.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/e7940746545f8bb396f74768098d64c6466898f2.png[/img]
but even by looking at the altitude indicator separately, it seems "it's too much." and there is.
On the screenshot above we see the maximum number of indicators and figures, in reality, it will look easier.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/c54468fa6da333f3d1da30522ca23aa9d76bd849.jpg[/img]
For example, in the most typical case, the altitude, trust, and vertical speed indicator will not look cluttered. 
-----------------------------------------------
So, that it for this week. Discuss, share and recommend the game to your friends. And write in the comments should we continue with this Headline.
Best,
Frontier Pilot Simulator Team.

[b]P.S. After a discount week we will launch 3 contests. The prize will be t-shirts, keys, and money. So, the one who didn't buy the game yet, purchase it and join Frontier Pilot Simulator Family.[/b]

notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/328410f90fe742e75ebfe7ccc4caaf7e033031ac.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29589799/fc5f08b4b905ebc1f85c83d87aad7e7658224cb6.png[/img][/url]

Thank you all for your reviews, comments, and suggestions.
We are sorry for the late update (been busy with the game exhibition), This update is focused on fixing the main bugs, which had been collected from your feedback.
Every next update will mainly focus on adding new features.

In a few words about the new update.
Optimization: Medium and weak PC owners, we made it special for you. Now you will have up to 38 FPS on medium and lowe graphic setting.
Also, thanks to our active players, We have rebalanced the flight time, fuel consumption, the goods creation time and passengers, as well as the cost of transportation.
Serious improvements touched the economic component of the game.
Especially super efficient "shuttle" routes. The gamer should be careful choose the goals of the flight, calculate the subsequent places of purchases and sales (Hello, Euro Truck Simulator :D). Also, we increased the flight range by 20-25%.
Regarding the HUD (It will be change completely in the next builds), but now we added the maximum speed indicator of flight, hinting to the player, fly at higher altitudes and efficiency of the flights will increase.

Details:

[h1]Performance[/h1]
Fps [b]INCREASED[/b]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Passenger delivery time [b]CHANGED[/b]
Menu [b]UPDATED[/b]
Refilling occurs in one click up to a full battery. (later on, it will be possible to set an arbitrary level of charge)
Battery - less consumption
F10 - Hide HUD
Trading mistake [b]FIXED[/b]
Camera rotation [b]FIXED[/b]
Saving issue [b]FIXED[/b]
Information about available upgrades on the bases [b]ADDED[/b] to the map
HOTAS Thrust inversion principle [b]CHANGED[/b] (Inversion occurs only by clamping the button)
Repairing price [b]UPDATED[/b]
Additional gameplay message
Fuel maximum level issue [b]FIXED[/b]
Interface [b]REWORKED[/b]
Time goods Production on Raglor increased
Repair time bar [b]ADDED[/b]
Fuel refiled 

[h1]HUD[/h1]
Maximum speed indicator [b]ADDED[/b] - helps to set optimal speed on every air layers

[h1]Sound[/h1]
HUD sound [b]ADDED[/b]
Hungar and repair sound [b]REWORKED[/b]
Trading and Map sound [b]ADDED[/b]
Music playlist play [b]REWORKED[/b]
Sound effect in general [b]IMPROVED[/b]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
Power station texture [b]REWORKED[/b]
Colony Center new texture [b]ADDED[/b]
Hungar optimization
Weather graphics [b]UPDATED[/b]

[h1]Ship[/h1]
Ship damaged [b]REWORKED [/b]
Ship chassis damaged [b]FIXED[/b]
Scarb - ground controlling [b]IMPROVED[/b]
Ox - cargo loading device [b]UPDATED[/b]

[h1]Controls[/h1]
X52 Saitek joystick issue partly [b]FIXED[/b]

[h1]Effects[/h1]
Engine effect [b]REWORKED[/b]
Сhassis animation - Scarb [b]IMPROVED[/b]
Rotation of the planet around the sun illumination [b]ADDED[/b] (The Polar Day effect)
BioSpray effect [b]REWORKED[/b]
